title: Apply Hans Laser logo branding (header + favicon)

requirements.summary: Create production-ready square PNG logo assets from uploaded hans logo.jpeg and place them in frontend/public/assets/generated.
acceptanceCriteria: New logo image files exist in frontend/public/assets/generated using the filenames specified in imageRequirements.required.
Generated images are cropped/fit to a clean square mark suitable for an app icon (no unintended clipping).
Images have consistent colors with the uploaded logo and look sharp at small sizes.

file_operations.description: Generate a crisp, square 512x512 PNG app icon derived from the uploaded hans logo.jpeg and save it exactly at frontend/public/assets/generated/hans-laser-app-icon.dim_512x512.png (clean crop/fit; no unintended clipping).

Generate a crisp, square 32x32 PNG favicon derived from the uploaded hans logo.jpeg and save it exactly at frontend/public/assets/generated/hans-laser-favicon.dim_32x32.png (optimized for small-size legibility).

Generate a crisp, square 180x180 PNG apple touch icon derived from the uploaded hans logo.jpeg and save it exactly at frontend/public/assets/generated/hans-laser-apple-touch-icon.dim_180x180.png (clean padding/crop suitable for iOS home screen).

requirements.summary: Replace the header’s current hardcoded logo source with the newly generated logo asset.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx uses the new generated logo filename (not /assets/generated/hans-laser-logo.dim_512x512.png).
The logo renders correctly in the header in both light and dark mode backgrounds (no broken image).

file_operations.description: Update the header branding image src to use the new generated logo asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/hans-laser-app-icon.dim_512x512.png (replace the current /assets/generated/hans-laser-logo.dim_512x512.png reference) and ensure it displays correctly on light/dark backgrounds.

requirements.summary: Add favicon and apple touch icon link tags in frontend/index.html using the newly generated logo assets.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html includes a favicon link pointing to the generated 32x32 (or 48x48) PNG.
frontend/index.html includes an apple-touch-icon link pointing to the generated 180x180 PNG.
After build, the browser tab favicon displays the new logo (no missing favicon requests in devtools network panel).

file_operations.description: Add <link> tags for favicon and apple touch icon in the document head pointing to frontend/public/assets/generated/hans-laser-favicon.dim_32x32.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/hans-laser-apple-touch-icon.dim_180x180.png, respectively, ensuring the build serves them without missing requests.
